name: Makeet
subtitle: Habits, at your pace
promotionalText: Choose your days, see progress in your calendar and make room for the weeks ahead. Every small step counts.
description:
Choose your days, count every small step and make room in your calendar. Habits that matter, at the pace of your life.

More than a checkmark
Count glasses, pages, minutes or repetitions, several times a day and beyond your goal. Minus on the left, plus on the right: adjust a quantity and keep going.

A week of your own
Monday, Tuesday and Thursday? Pick days for each habit, along with a goal, increment, icon or emoji. Rest days do not break your streak.

A history you can correct
Edit past-day quantities from the calendar, review and save. You can also change a habit, archive it, restore it or permanently delete it and its progress after confirmation.

A plan that looks ahead
Plan today, 7, 14 or 28 days. Makeet suggests slots using your chosen days, preferred times, progress and commitments. Review and confirm before future events are created.

Calendars, with your permission
Choose which device calendars to read and where to add Makeet blocks. Google Calendar works when configured on your device; events sync according to the calendar provider’s settings.

See what works for you
Explore quantities, consistency, streaks and logging times. Trends shows the previous three complete months and the current month, including periods without entries. Detailed statistics help you notice your patterns. The medium widget shows three habits with compact controls.

Goals to reach or limits to respect
Choose a goal to reach or a limit not to exceed, including zero. Occurrences above the limit count as a penalty. Confirm zero to distinguish a day with no occurrences from an unlogged day. If you enable it, minus can take your balance below zero; history and statistics preserve the sign.

FREE, INCLUDING ACCOUNT SYNC
Makeet is free: unlimited habits, statistics, planning and private sync across devices. No subscriptions or in-app purchases. Stay on your device or sign in with Apple, Google or a verified username and password. If you already have an account, add credentials from Account to keep your progress.

Available in Italian, English, French, German and Spanish. Your own habit names and units stay as you write them.

reviewNotes:
Makeet is a free quantitative habit tracker. All features, including private account sync, are free. No subscriptions or in-app purchases are offered in this release.

1. Onboarding offers local/device storage or optional Apple, Google or verified username/password access. No account is required for local use. Registration and recovery require an email code. Existing provider users can add credentials from Account while retaining their private archive. Use the dedicated verified reviewer account supplied with the submission for account features; no personal provider password is required. Importing an existing local archive requires an explicit choice.
2. Tap + to create a habit. Choose weekdays, icon or emoji, daily target and logging step. Choose Reach for a minimum goal, or Do not exceed for a maximum, including zero. A limit habit needs an explicit zero confirmation for a day without occurrences; amounts above the limit are shown as a penalty.
3. Allow negative values is optional per habit. When enabled, minus can take the balance below zero. Signed quantities remain visible in statistics, calendar and history. Existing habits keep their original minimum-goal behavior.
4. Calendar shows the monthly heatmap and supports explicit past-day corrections with Save/Cancel and Set to zero. Habit detail supports editing, archive/restore and confirmed permanent deletion.
5. Planning and calendar integration are free. Select readable source calendars and a writable destination, review the proposed future blocks, and confirm before any event is written. Limit habits do not generate action proposals. Google calendars use accounts configured on the device through EventKit; Google identity sign-in does not grant Calendar access.
6. Profile editing, JSON export, account deletion, reminders and widgets do not require a paid entitlement. Calendar event contents remain on the device. No advertising or advertising tracking is included.
7. Today uses compact controls and a leading checkbox for explicit zero. Trends shows the last three complete months plus the current month, including empty periods; tap a habit for detailed statistics. The medium widget shows three habits.

whatsNew: A more compact Home and widgets: the medium widget shows three habits, and a checkbox confirms zero. Add credentials from Account to keep your progress. Makeet remains entirely free.
